scope: Existing authenticated backup 512-real / 256-complex Q15 chain and selected helpers only
prerequisites: Authenticated CK804ef simulator supporting the actual packed DSP/loop/load-store instructions; backend instruction probes must pass before vectors
Identical locked stock tables and explicit ABI/register/stack/memory fixtures for stock assembly and C ELF
Four-byte aligned buffers, guarded mapped memory and captured signed-halfword output; all descriptor pointer widths/fields fixed explicitly
Pin source, tool, output ELF, simulator, fixture/table hashes and C macro configuration

helper_corpus.shift_case_definition: 10 lengths x 7 shifts x separate/in-place; repeat edge_samples cyclically, starting at index0
helper_corpus.copy_case_definition: 10 lengths x separate/in-place using cyclic edge_samples; no unsupported overlapping ranges
helper_corpus.bitreversal_case_definition: Authenticated 256-length table; uniquely labelled 32-bit complex samples, alternating extrema, deterministic full-range random. Compare expected permutation independently of FFT arithmetic.

FFT_case_definition: 14 deterministic patterns x forward/inverse x complex256/real512; complex inputs have512 signed halfwords, real forward inputs512; inverse spectra must have explicitly validated descriptor/buffer shapes. bitreverse=1, modifier=1, stock tables. Compare kernels/stages and wrapper endpoints independently.
risk_hypotheses: Q15 saturation boundaries versus lane wraparound
Arithmetic right shift and negative odd rounding
Order of packed halving/add/sub and multiply truncation
Real split endpoint/DC/Nyquist handling, packed lane order and -32768 correction
Inverse wrapper final doubling with truncating halfword stores
Compiler treatment of signed left shift/overflow in the authentic C source; no portable-C equivalence inferred
stopping_criteria: Stop on unsupported opcode, ABI fault, invalid descriptor shape, unmapped access or guard corruption; classify execution infrastructure before numerical conclusions
On first numerical mismatch, retain hashes/input/first differing stage/index and bounded minimize the case without changing source/flags/tables; report mismatch rather than sweeping configurations
If all233 helper cases plus56 FFT cases pass exactly, report finite corpus equality only; no universal semantic equivalence, startup selection, physical audio or full-firmware byte identity
Do not use forward/inverse roundtrip identity or float tolerance as a substitute for exact assembly-vs-C comparison: documented stage scaling/truncation prevents unqualified identity
